stages.learnerPrompt: What catastrophic failure physics occur when capacity limits or downstream dependencies degrade under peak load?

referenceMaterial.summary: Failure physics analysis: Pod Rotated → JVM Caches Stale IP → Traffic to Dead Pod → 💥 Connection Resets.
failureModes: Cascading Failure: BGP sessions repeatedly tear down and re-establish every 10 seconds. Route updates flood the internal routing table, causing route flap damping algorithms to penalize and suppress the route for 30 minutes, cutting off all hybrid connectivity.
Breakdown Chain: Pod Rotated → JVM Caches Stale IP → Traffic to Dead Pod → 💥 Connection Resets
Shedding Failure: Without fast rejection at the boundary, queued dead work triggers multi-second GC pauses, CPU thrashing, and cascading 504 Gateway Timeouts.
